identity_notes: Digests are over the checkpoint's own metadata files, read from the serving directory; no path is recorded, because a machine path is not part of the measurement and does not ship. weights_index_sha256 covers model.safetensors.index.json, which pins the shard layout and every tensor-to-shard assignment without hashing the weight files themselves. inference_server_version and max_model_len were read from the running server's /version and /v1/models at registration time. A draw taken against a server reporting different values is not a draw against this registration.
max_tokens_policy: one request per attempt at the fixed budget above. qwen36 is a thinking model and spends reasoning tokens before content, so the budget is set high enough to finish rather than raised on failure: re-sampling at a larger budget produces a fresh generation under a condition the other draws did not run under, which makes the accepted draws a sample from more than one distribution. An empty completion is an invalid draw, archived with its reason and replaced under this same condition.
